item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 4
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 4. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. Subaru woke up on Emilia's lap at first in their carriage, which was actually in the Pleiades tower. Then everyone is there. I was thinking why? Probably Shaula gathered them or they happened to be there after the end of season 2. But if she gathered, then I think she prioritized Subaru at first, so it's likely the latter case.

Then she thought Subaru is her master, Flugel, because he smelled s***. Some people like Rem hates his smell and from how Shaula said, I think she also hates it so she probably can sense the witch's smell like Rem. Also, she lives for a long time, and seems she is not a human, neither? She said someone died 400 years ago or so, so... what is she? And even though her name is Shaula, it seems she is not the sage. Then Flugel somehow asked her to prevent anyone from coming to the tower and she obeyed all along, but why? So, I assume there is something too strong or too useful in the tower like other fantasy story does. By the way, everyone doesn't know "Flugel" except that the person who planted a large tree was the one Subaru defeated the white whale with in the past.

Then, Subaru went to a room with spirits, where looks like a jungle. And Patrasche was there because the room has a healing effect to them. Rem was also there but Rem couldn't be cured because her state wasn't an injury nor mind issue. Ram decided to be there to take care of Rem.

Then Subaru went to the 4th floor, which is the first exam of the tower to enter into a library of the tower. Subaru found the monolith, which looks like a stone of which height was the similar as humans, and when he touched, the exam started. The exam was to start appearing the number of monoliths and they needed to find the right monolith. While he was thinking and talking with his friends, he noticed by looking at the Shaula and her hair. She said before that her hair style was not a pony tail, but a scorpion tail, and that made him realized that the exam was about the constellation. This made me think, did someone come from another world besides Subaru? And because they came from another world, that they had the smell of the witch, and was it Flugel?

Anyhow, Subaru found the right monolith and went to a library and ended the episode.

After watching the 2nd time, it made me think a few things. Shaula guarded the watchtower to protect the Great Pleiades Library, and that library and the tower was built by Flugel. It appears he has a strong authority or magic power to build it. Also, she likes her scorpion hair and also her hair pin is with a star. She has a memory or something for that hair. Beako worried about how Shaula would behave if she found out Subaru isn't Flugel. Especially Flugel ordered her not to talk to anyone, which Subaru said he was a terrible person to do so, so maybe she knows something important.

Then, Reid, who was the first Saint, was a scumbag and Shaula was beaten by him. Maybe, Subaru will travel in the past and meet with them, just like other fantasy does.

Then, this episode also showed how Subaru's basic ability is high. He has a lot of knowledge for a myth, and a constellation.

Most of this episode is for story, and didn't notice the details of animation or music that much.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 4
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 4. This episode was one of the episodes I was waiting for in this season the most. Turned out that it was a little bit too fast after Ayanokoji found out what was Housen up to. I expected Horikita was more like in a panic when he got a knife in his left hand and also Sudo was almost shocked, and also they needed to take care of its bleeding. These entire reactions were removed and I felt they were too calm down even though they were just high school students in that school, except maybe Housen only. His reaction was good and maybe a director or producer thought that was enough? Also, I remembered he would say that he couldn't understand how Ayanokoji was so good before stabbing his knife, and that was one phrase I liked.

Besides, the exam showed that Ayanokoji's math score was 100 and better than anyone else, but there was no explanation how good it was, so the episode skipped a lot I felt.

Housen's fighting with Sudo and Horikita was kinda good, especially Horikita can actually fight and she could even do jump spinning kick. They still couldn't even have a chance against Housen, though. In this season, there will be more fighting scenes so maybe they'll be interested in.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 4
item.description: Episode 4 moves a lot of story points. Maybe one of the most important episodes since season 1. I read a manga for this, but it's great how Ruby didn't feel anything about manipulating other people and talk with her smile and joy about how she behaved badly to others. Also, on the anime, it's great expressions and voice performance to see how Aqua was disappointed and went to gloomy when he was all wrong. He was all emotional and even his alter ego blamed him in his mind. It's kinda pitty but this really gives me how he wants to live for himself. And then, Akane. I didn't remember in the manga how Akane figured out Kamiki, but this episode on to that scene, too. Unlike Ruby's black star on her eyes, Akane has yellow star on her eyes and they also lightened up when she got a new actress award and she found out the Kamiki. It shows how Akane wants to help Aqua here as his girlfriend. That's a good comparison. Anyway, she should go into a police officer or FBI. Kana, on the other hand, also wants to help him as she was fallen in a love with him while he was just sitting on a bench but he made his head down. But Aqua rejected because he was in his own world at that time, and he was so shocked that he couldn't chase her nor he couldn't care her. For an half year to enjoy his own life with Akane really makes him peaceful, appearantly.
